task.title: Adjust Catalog view for wide viewports
task.description:
I'm currently using a monitor with a 2560x1440 resolution. On the catalog page, the card grid only takes up about half the available space. The grid should flexibly fit the whole available viewport.
Also, the grid always displays just 50 cards, which also looks weird at most view sizes because the # of cards doesn't divide evenly unless you happen to have rows of 5, which the breakpoints never give you (it goes from 6 to 4).
Let's instead make the grid show 60 at a time, which has a lot more divisors, anything from 2-6 cards per row divides evenly, and after 6 the grid should stay there until it jumps to 10/row at very wide viewports like mine.
